title: When the Witness Breaks
author: August Galloway
blurb: Yara Joubert, a night-shift dispatcher for a taxi company, has quietly solved three deaths the police called accidents. But when a body turns up dressed in clothes stolen from the witness's own closet, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must trap a killer who knows the case file better than the investigators do, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
